get.description: Role-scoped queue/history. from/to inclusively filter due_by dates. days_waiting counts whole elapsed 24-hour periods, stopped at completion/cancellation. EVC duration is a DEMO ASSUMPTION.

SIMULATED authorised selector (stand-in). Read-only DEMO ranking, not a panel appointment or reservation. Returns exactly N experts or an explained shortage. Ordered criteria: eligibility, expertise, workload, rotation, UUID. RO readers require their own case and SAME_REGION policy; cross-region preview requires a global pool-reader role.

post.description: Plan dates/AM-PM slots for QUEUED requests in scope with the EDF baseline (default) or CP-SAT over the same locked input; both are scored by the same metrics. Panels come from the SIMULATED authorised selector (stand-in); optimisation never picks experts. Writes a schedule_run, unpublished DEMO_PANEL assignments (which reserve their experts and slot capacity) and PROPOSED requests; unscheduled requests stay QUEUED. run_id is chosen by the caller and conflicts if reused. slot_capacity (DEMO ASSUMPTION) creates missing AM/PM slot rows in the horizon. RO users are limited to their own region. Optional Idempotency-Key.

Publish every proposal of one run in a single transaction after rechecking eligibility, COI, activity, expertise, panel size, window and slot capacity against published commitments. Any double booking or failed recheck returns 409 and publishes nothing. Requests become PUBLISHED, which EvcPort.status reports. Optional Idempotency-Key.
The whole event log as OCEL 2.0, national scope, for oversight roles. No payloads or personal references.
